mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMTNLEADERSCHDUL ( SCHDUL_ID, SCHDUL_NM, SCHDUL_CN, SCHDUL_PLACE, SCHDUL_BGNDE, SCHDUL_ENDDE, SCHDUL_SE, SCHDUL_DEPT_ID, SCHDUL_KIND_CODE, SCHDUL_IPCR_CODE, SCHDUL_CHARGER_ID, ATCH_FILE_ID, REPTIT_SE_CODE, FRST_REGISTER_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID ) VALUES ( #{schdulId}, #{schdulNm}, #{schdulCn}, #{schdulPlace}, #{schdulBgnde}, #{schdulEndde}, #{schdulSe}, #{schdulDeptId}, #{schdulKindCode}, #{schdulIpcrCode}, #{schdulChargerId}, #{atchFileId}, #{reptitSeCode}, SYSDATE, #{frstRegisterId} )
mapper.select: SELECT SCHDUL_ID, SCHDUL_NM "title", to_char(to_date(SCHDUL_BGNDE,'yyyymmddHH24miss'),'yyyy-mm-dd"T"HH24:mi:ss' )"start" , to_char(to_date(SCHDUL_ENDDE,'yyyymmddHH24miss'),'yyyy-mm-dd"T"HH24:mi:ss')"end", SCHDUL_PLACE, SCHDUL_CN FROM COMTNLEADERSCHDUL
